answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The sonnet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the juniper. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. What survives to the mesa is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
